composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Model an original thirty-eight-year-old adult bust in warm terracotta, with a broad composed face and softly defined eyes. Wrap a cream linen high collar fully around the shoulders and chest, preserving clear fabric folds. Turn the face slightly left. Grazing light distinguishes clay tool marks from woven cloth against muted teal, without resemblance to a known person. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
